annotations.title: Google Antigravity Multi-Step Autonomous Coding & Workflow Agent

description: Dispatches a complex engineering or operational task to Google's Antigravity autonomous agent for multi-step planning, tool orchestration, and verified execution. Use when solving multi-stage software engineering or workflow tasks that require autonomous planning; for compiling exhaustive multi-source literature and market research dossiers, use conduct_deep_research_investigation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('execution_mode' defaults to 'autonomous_verified'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (150 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

execution_mode.description: Autonomy policy for subtask execution; defaults to 'autonomous_verified' when omitted.

input.description: High-level task objective and constraints for the Antigravity autonomous agent.

name: execute_antigravity_agent

output.description: Synthesized final deliverable and action trace summary.

success.description: True when the agent completed all planned steps.

title: Google Antigravity Multi-Step Autonomous Coding & Workflow Agent
